pages.label: Home
pages.purpose: The journal's front door. Communicates identity, current issue, editorial ethos, and drives submissions.
decisions: Devanagari wordmark leads; roman transliteration and Sanskrit shloka reinforce the brand identity.
Sticky header condenses on scroll — the Submit Paper CTA and search stay always reachable.
Current-issue spotlight above the fold; latest papers, editorial pillars, and Call-for-Papers band drive action.

pages.label: About
pages.purpose: Editorial vision, mission, and the meaning behind the journal's name.
decisions: Two-column layout: long-form editorial voice on the left, at-a-glance facts on the right.
Editorial pillars grid at the bottom reinforces credibility (integrity · reach · craft · care).

pages.label: Aim & Scope
pages.purpose: The disciplines and article types Viśvasaṃvid publishes.
decisions: Categories rendered as iconic feature cards — scannable at a glance for prospective authors.
Article types listed explicitly so authors self-select before opening the submission form.

pages.label: Editorial Board
pages.purpose: Meet the Editor-in-Chief, associate editors, advisory board, and reviewer panel.
decisions: Grouped by role with an accent-ringed avatar treatment — reads as scholarly, not corporate.
Managing Editor and international advisory board surface early to establish authority and reach.

pages.label: Instructions for Authors
pages.purpose: Manuscript preparation, structure, submission checklist, and templates.
decisions: Long-form manuscript rules on the left, downloadable templates and warnings on the right — actionable while reading.
Callouts highlight file-size and anonymisation reminders before authors submit.

pages.label: Publication Ethics
pages.purpose: The journal's COPE-aligned ethics stance.
decisions: Info callout up top signals COPE alignment; the rest is legible long-form prose.

pages.label: Copyright Policy
pages.purpose: Author rights and open-access licensing.
decisions: Success callout foregrounds the key promise: authors keep copyright.

pages.label: Peer Review Policy
pages.purpose: How submissions are reviewed and decided.
decisions: Four numbered steps visualise the process before the policy detail.

pages.label: Current Issue
pages.purpose: The most recent published issue and its papers.
decisions: Issue hero surfaces volume/issue/date badges up front for citation-conscious readers.
Paper cards keep meta (category · date · pages · authors) scannable in the grid.

pages.label: Archive
pages.purpose: Browse past volumes and issues.
decisions: Two views (by-volume accordion / all-issues grid) via tabs — both academic browsing habits supported.

pages.label: Paper detail
pages.purpose: A single scholarly article — the destination for citation, download, and sharing.
decisions: Google-Scholar citation_* meta tags + ScholarlyArticle JSON-LD emitted for indexing.
How-to-cite panel with APA / MLA copy-buttons directly under the abstract.
Download PDF and DOI resolver are the primary sidebar actions; open-access notice reassures readers.

pages.label: Submit Paper
pages.purpose: The manuscript submission form.
decisions: Sectioned form (author · co-authors · manuscript · files · declaration) with repeatable co-author rows.
Drag-and-drop upload with PDF/DOCX + 5 MB guardrails; the declaration is a distinct card, not a lost checkbox.
Sidebar checklist + editorial timeline callout reduce back-and-forth with the editorial office.

pages.label: Search results
pages.purpose: Full-text search across papers, authors, and keywords.
decisions: Filters and sort are URL-synced (useSearchParams + useTransition) so results are shareable and back-button friendly.
Result-count + pagination + empty-state cover all three list-page states.

pages.label: Contact
pages.purpose: Reach the editorial office.
decisions: Form on the left, editorial contact details + response-time callout on the right — everything above the fold on desktop.

pages.label: Privacy Policy
pages.purpose: Data handling for authors, reviewers, and readers.
decisions: Standard long-form legal template using the branded prose treatment.

pages.label: Terms & Conditions
pages.purpose: The website's usage terms.
decisions: Matches Privacy Policy in tone and structure so the legal footer feels cohesive.

pages.label: 404 · Not found
pages.purpose: A graceful, on-brand off-ramp when a URL doesn't resolve.
decisions: Compass ornament, apologetic-but-brief copy, and two clear escape routes (home / search).

pages.label: Style Guide (internal)
pages.purpose: Internal reference: palette, type scale, and every reusable component in one place.
decisions: Gated `noIndex`; renders every primitive so the design team can review consistency at a glance.

pages.label: Admin sign-in
pages.purpose: Editorial team entry point.
decisions: Centered on-brand card, no site chrome — signals a distinct, protected surface.
Copy makes access boundaries explicit ('invited editorial staff only').

pages.label: Admin dashboard
pages.purpose: At-a-glance operational overview for editors.
decisions: Four stat cards → recent submissions table; primary actions ('+ New issue', '+ New paper') sit in the header.
Sidebar collapses to a Sheet on mobile so the whole console is usable on the go.

pages.label: Volumes
pages.purpose: Manage journal volumes (add/edit/delete).
decisions: Consistent list-page pattern reused across all admin screens: header + search + responsive table + row actions.
'Add volume' opens a right-side drawer — modal-lite, non-blocking, keyboard accessible.

pages.label: Issues
pages.purpose: Manage journal issues.
decisions: Vol · Issue chip in the first column keeps orientation fast when scanning long lists.

pages.label: Papers
pages.purpose: Manage published papers.
decisions: Row actions include Publish alongside Edit/View/Delete so mid-issue changes are one click away.

pages.label: Editorial Board
pages.purpose: Manage the editorial board.
decisions: Avatar + name + affiliation in a single cell — faster to scan than four separate columns.

pages.label: Submissions
pages.purpose: Incoming manuscripts awaiting action.
decisions: Status colour-coded (received · under review · accepted · rejected · published) for triage.
Row actions: Open · Accept · Reject — the three most common editorial decisions.

pages.label: Pages
pages.purpose: Manage static content pages (policies, about, etc.).
decisions: Draft vs published pill in the status column; slug shown so editors know the public URL.

pages.label: Home — mobile nav drawer
pages.purpose: The mobile navigation Sheet open — full nav + search + submit CTA.
decisions: Nav collapses to a right-side Sheet under 1024px; grouped items become accordions so nothing is buried.
